value.body: The Indian Coast Guard recruits pilots who already hold a Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) as Assistant Commandants under a short service appointment (CPL-SSA). They fly the Coast Guard's aircraft for maritime surveillance, search and rescue, and pollution response. It is an officer-level entry open to men and women.

items.label: Licence
items.note: Valid on the date of application

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics (55% aggregate in these for General/OBC/EWS, 50% for SC/ST) and a current CPL. Selection follows the Coast Guard officer process: the Coast Guard Common Admission Test (CGCAT), a Preliminary Selection Board, a Final Selection Board (including pilot aptitude tests) and a medical exam.

value.title: At a glance
items: Few posts are offered in each batch.
It suits CPL holders who want a flying role in a uniformed service rather than an airline.
Short service appointment means a fixed tenure; check the current notification for extension rules.
Medical and physical standards for aircrew are strict.
